mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_media_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND progress_ms > 0 AND (duration_ms IS NULL OR duration_ms = 0 OR progress_ms < 0.95 * duration_ms) ORDER BY last_play_time DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.* FROM t_media_item i JOIN t_media_metadata m ON m.id = i.metadata_id WHERE i.directory_id = #{directoryId} AND m.poster_path IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.file_last_modified DESC NULLS LAST, i.create_time DESC, i.id LIMIT 1
